redactions: Local absolute paths and serialized OS paths
Player/participant names and IDs pseudonymized with a private HMAC key
Email, IP address and credential-shaped values removed
caveats: Pseudonymization is not a guarantee of anonymity.
Infrastructure tests and bot traces are not expert human demonstrations.
Archive containers excluded; their JSON/JSONL members were imported and deduplicated.
Unique byte objects and JSONL rows are not counts of unique fights.
